purpose: Claim candidates the Phase 2 extractor should surface from the demo dossier. Used to measure claim_candidate_recall and claim_candidate_precision per ClaimType once extraction exists.
scope_notes: Annotated against the real spans listed in demo_spans.json.
Coverage is intentionally selective: enough to validate the Phase 2 vertical slice, not exhaustive.
claim_type values mirror src/locuslab/models.py::ClaimType: numeric, citation, clinical_performance, safety, benefit_risk, completeness, classification, other.
text_fragment is a substring expected to appear in the span text; not an exact match requirement.

expected_claims.rationale: Device description paragraph asserts MDR risk-class classification (Class IIa, active). Deterministic regex over span text is sufficient to surface this.
expected_claims.phase_3_link: Classification rationale is regulatory-judgment territory; expect ECO-MANUAL flag for adjudication (see GOLD-FINDING-005).
